post.caption:
40 minutes talking about him. Allah heard every word. 🤍

“Indeed, prayer prohibits immorality and wrongdoing.” (29:45)

Let your prayer clean your tongue too. Before Maghrib: say one good thing about the person you talked about. 🤲
post.youtube_title: 40 minutes talking about him. Allah heard every word. 🤍 #islam #backbiting

captions: 3:10 p.m. A park bench. Your friend on speaker.
“Did you see what Bilal posted?” And you laugh.
His job. His marriage. His weight. Forty minutes.
Then, across the park: the adhan for Asr.
And your own words are still hanging in the air.
You hang up. Cold water over your hands.
You rinse your mouth. Three times.
On the mat, every word you said comes back.
After salam, you text him: “Proud of you, brother.”
